The '''Eleventh Pius Dea Crusade''' was a religious [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusade]] orchestrated by the [[Pius Dea]] cult against the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], an ancient spacefaring species. In [[11,707 BBY]], [[11,791 BBY|over eighty years]] after the [[Crusade of the Wilds|previous crusade]], the Pius Dea-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched an invasion of [[Herglic Space/Legends|Herglic Space]] to the south of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eleventh Pius Dea Crusade first appeared in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. While the Eleventh Crusade is not mentioned explicitly in the text, the Crusade appears on a map of the Crusades and their movement across the galaxy.<ref name="EGW" />
